name: Transport abstraction layer
description: Shared package (packages/transport/) with TransportPublisher/TransportSubscriber interfaces, NATSTransport (wrapping @nats-io/transport-node + @nats-io/jetstream), InMemoryTransport (EventEmitter-based for bun test), DualWriteTransport (primary + secondary for migration), and MetafactoryEvent type (CloudEvents v1.0 envelope with mf* extensions per DD-68). ~200 lines. This is the foundation all other P-5xx features build on.

name: NATS-native cue consumer
description: Pulse subscribes to mf.{network_id}.cue.> for cue events via JetStream consumer (pulse-cue-eval). AckExplicit with backoff. Build subscription interfaces + mock cue emitter for testing — cue evaluation logic is out of scope. NATS accounts configured from Stage 1 per DD-72. Depends on P-500.

name: Cue.fired event publisher
description: Pulse publishes cue.fired events to mf.{network_id}.cue.fired with CloudEvents envelope (DD-68). Closes the activation loop from DD-62. Subject pattern: mf.{net_id}.cue.fired per DD-69. Depends on P-501.

name: Process execution events on bus
description: Publish pulse.process.started/completed/failed events to NATS for Miner observability and Grove dashboard visibility. Subject: mf.{network_id}.pulse.process.{started|completed|failed}. CloudEvents envelope. Depends on P-502.
